text: The JRC GFC2020 V4 dataset shows that there was no forest on the property in 2020. This dataset is a forest/non-forest reference map for 2020 and indicates a share of 0.0% forest cover for the asset. The Hansen GFC GFC-2025-v1.13 dataset also supports this finding, as it shows tree-cover loss events before 2020 but not after.
